diagnostic_scope: FIXED 100-SAMPLE CV-BENCH SCREENING. This is a diagnostic attribution experiment and is explicitly NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. No formal accuracy, promotion, acceleration or hardware claim may be derived from it.
round_scope: CPU-only summariser, preregistration and tests. No GPU run, no board run, no training, no hyper-parameter tuning, no dependency installation. The L2 screening100 raw JSONL is produced later by the host GPU runner exactly as pinned below; it did not exist when this file was written.
diagnostic_question: On the fixed screening100 sample, is the current integer Selector's shortfall against dense primarily a ranker/scoring defect or primarily a consequence of pruning too early at boundary B1 (after vision block 0)?

score_modes.current_integer: current integer selector (selector_integer_scorer_audit.integer_chain + accepted compact hardware-regular selection contract)
score_modes.l2: run_hf_hardware_regular_b1.py --score-mode l2 (min-max normalised B1 group-mean L2)

primary_metric.definition: Official CV-Bench combined score returned by the frozen scorer evaluation.build_cv_bench_pruning_report.score: ((accuracy_ADE20K + accuracy_COCO)/2 + accuracy_Omni3D)/2.
primary_metric.rule: This is the ONE and ONLY primary metric for every arm (dense, current integer, L2) and for every paired bootstrap comparison. It is never replaced by any other accuracy.

unweighted_metric.definition: Plain unweighted mean over the 100 screening samples.
unweighted_metric.rule: Secondary diagnostic only. It must never be called the CV-Bench primary score and must never drive the decision rule.

dense.subset_rule: restricted to the 100 sample_id values of datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl, preserving manifest order
dense.role: unpruned custom-dense reference for both the L2 and current-integer arms
dense.note: This is the same frozen custom dense JSONL that the formal current-Selector quality report names as dense_jsonl.

current_integer.subset_rule: restricted to the 100 sample_id values of datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl, preserving manifest order

l2.role: L2 scorer on the identical B1/block-0 cut point, K=96, screening100
l2.generation_command: python evaluation/run_hf_hardware_regular_b1.py --model <frozen BF16 RoboBrain2.5-4B> --model-label <label> --manifest datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-b1-l2-diagnostic/b1_l2_k96_screening100.jsonl --score-mode l2 --budget 96 --region-grid 3 --local-candidate-cap 16 --dtype bf16 --device cuda:0

validation_requirements.sample_id_identity: The screening manifest, the dense full2638 subset, the current-selector_k96 full2638 subset and the L2 screening100 input must all select exactly the same 100 sample_id values.
validation_requirements.no_duplicates: Each of the four inputs must contain no duplicate sample_id.
validation_requirements.l2_score_mode: Every L2 record must have score_mode == "l2".
validation_requirements.l2_requested_budget: Every L2 record must have requested_budget == 96.
validation_requirements.input_grid_consistency: For every sample_id, the L2 record's (image_grid_thw, full_patch_tokens, full_llm_visual_tokens) must equal the current integer record's tuple. A mismatch invalidates the comparison and the summariser must fail closed.
validation_requirements.fail_closed: If any required input file is missing, or any of the checks above fails, the summariser must raise and must NOT write a report.

decision_rule.uses: 95% CI of score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] (l2_minus_current), plus each arm's relative retention vs dense (arm cv_bench_accuracy / dense cv_bench_accuracy)

ordered_rules.meaning: 排序器缺陷为主要因素：L2 scorer 在同一 B1 切点上显著优于 current integer selector 超过 0.02。

ordered_rules.condition: l2_minus_current 95% CI upper bound <= 0.02 AND L2 relative retention vs dense < 0.92 AND current relative retention vs dense < 0.92
ordered_rules.meaning: B1过早裁剪为主要因素：在同一切点上 L2 与 current 都没有显著优于对方超过 0.02，且两者相对 dense 都低于 0.92。
mixed/inconclusive：证据不足以把主因单独归给排序器或 B1 过早裁剪。

explicit_non_formal_statement: This diagnostic runs on a fixed stratified 100-sample screening set. Its result is an attribution signal only and is NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion; it must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach, and it does not authorise promotion, RTL work or hardware claims.
limitations: Screening100 is a diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample CV-Bench benchmark.
The Selector path is software only; no FPGA/board result and no latency/acceleration claim is made.

L2 and current integer share the B1 cut point but differ in scoring; dense uses the frozen custom dense path (a different preprocessing vintage), so dense is only a reference, not an exactly matched input grid.
Only score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] drives the decision; unweighted_sample_accuracy is descriptive.
Validation was already used in development; internal test remains sealed.
